**Verdict: FAIL** on candidate `sha256:4b84bf20…1cba1b5b` (source `654e39d`, 2732 files; the candidate ID matches). HEAD is the freeze commit `2efdc024e`, which adds only metadata outside the manifest on top of `654e39d`.

I had no open findings, so the verifications file is `{ "verifications": [] }`. I raised two new findings.

### Findings
- **F-DG6-300 (High, mandatory, REQ-S10-002, owner backend-workflow-engineer).** A sensitive benefit is not hidden from a workstream member without the grant. Readers who get 404 on the benefit (TL, AUD, a second BO) can still read it through other views:
  - **Traceability graph:** `getTraceability` returns its id, code and title (`reporting/traceability.ts:291-306`).
  - **Missing-links report:** `getMissingLinks` returns the same (`missing-links-facts.ts:99-142`).
  - **G6 readiness:** the message names its code and title (`gate-facts.ts` with `g6.ts:50-57`).
  - **Live register report:** the benefits register shows its title and planned value (7654321.1234 SAR) to TL (`reports/routes.ts:129-141`, `assemblers/registers.ts:180-275`).
  - **Stored report snapshot:** TL can generate one, and TL and AUD can then read the same row. Exports of that selection are refused under D-199, but the live report and the snapshot are not checked, so the refusal is bypassed.
  - **Change impact preview:** `impact.ts:381-415` has the same pattern (I read it but did not run it).

  A sweep of 128 transformation-scoped GETs on the demo data confirms it: the lists and dashboards filter correctly, and traceability and the live register report leak. The BE-B2 handback had listed traceability, impact and missing links as "not done", and no later task picked them up.
- **F-DG6-301 (Low, owner frontend-ux-engineer).** `problems-all.test.ts` does not collect codes inside `problems.validation([...])`. Three of them have no en/ar text: `validation.commit_on_behalf_of`, `validation.credential_refs`, `validation.unknown_version`. Users see the localized generic "not valid" text instead.

### Open questions from D-211
- **BE-Z4:** correct on every path I tried. The case, decision and link are absent from lists, return 404 by item and write, are redacted in the inbox, My Work and audit, and their deep link returns 403. They are not indexed by search or the assistant.
- **Ids and codes on action rows, meeting actions and controls:** acceptable under ADR-0051, since they carry none of the benefit's values. One observation: an executive ask or blocker status accepts a restricted case UUID and so confirms it exists. It needs the UUID and discloses no content, so I did not raise it.
- **FE-Z2 field-error mapping:** reveals nothing new about IT's bindings; it only localizes errors the API already returns to that caller. The `problems-all` gap it disclosed is real (F-DG6-301).
- **Credential-less egress:** an acceptable residual, as in round 3, left to the documented egress policy.
- **ADR-0011:** the missing object store is documentation drift with no behavioural effect, recorded as an observation.

### Checks run
- **Static:** typecheck, lint, format, OpenAPI lint (932 operations), no-CDN and build all exit 0. Historical validators pass for DG5 to DG1.
- **Unit tests, Node 22 and 24:** every test passes. Both full runs exit 1 only because of vitest's own RPC timeout under load; re-running that project alone exits 0 on both.
- **Integration, both locales:** 417/417 files, 4217 passed, 1 skipped and 1 todo (both declared).
- **Deferred e2e:** the A17, A12 and secret-ref-unbound specs pass 28/28.
- **Role sweeps:** AUD write-deny passes; the ADM-only sweep finds no leak.

### Disclosures
- **Disk:** the shared volume filled up during the run. Several shard attempts failed with no space left and are void; every one is kept and explained in CS-07.
- **Missed file:** one of my probes was present when an unset-locale shard collected its files, which shifted the sharding. One file (`gate-condition-escalation.test.ts`) ran in no shard; I ran it alone and it passes.
- **Round number:** the assignment's record-format section says `round: 3`. I wrote 4 and said so in the record.
- **Cleanup refused:** my disposable clone is removed. A wider removal of the test suites' temporary folders was refused, so I left them for the runner to delete when the run ends.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-4/`:
- `code-security-reviewer.json`
- `code-security-reviewer.findings.json`
- `code-security-reviewer.verifications.json`

Evidence and reproductions are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/code-security/round-4/`.
